manifest top-level keys == heroine hsc19 manifest
canonical loader actions: required present with loop flags, only optional extra = skill
action key set == heroine action key set
contract fields == heroine (cell, pivot, facing, scale, proportion)
one-shot action durations == heroine (attack/dodge/skill/hit/defeat ticks)
attack contact pose starts at the heroine contact tick (4)
attack has anticipation (lean back, blade behind) -> contact (lunge) -> recovery
defeat ends kneeling with eyes shut; victory poses distinct from idle
sheet is a cell multiple, 6 columns, each cell == its pose PNG
idle silhouette distinct from heroine idle (IoU < 0.8, not a recolour)
still package pixels == idle-a
all asset names <= 140 chars and in project/subject/purpose/variant/timestamp-id form
